roles/cloudfunctions.admin.title: Cloud Functions Admin
roles/cloudfunctions.admin.desc: Full access to functions, operations and locations.

roles/cloudfunctions.developer.title: Cloud Functions Developer
roles/cloudfunctions.developer.desc: Read and write access to all functions-related resources.

roles/cloudfunctions.invoker.title: Cloud Functions Invoker
roles/cloudfunctions.invoker.desc: Ability to invoke 1st gen HTTP functions with restricted access. 2nd gen functions need the Cloud Run Invoker role instead.

roles/cloudfunctions.serviceAgent.title: (Deprecated) Cloud Functions Service Agent
roles/cloudfunctions.serviceAgent.desc: Gives Cloud Functions service account access to managed resources.

roles/cloudfunctions.viewer.title: Cloud Functions Viewer
roles/cloudfunctions.viewer.desc: Read-only access to functions and locations.
